research_highlights: The 2026 edition runs Sunday, 9 August 2026, starting 05:00 WIB, based along Pantai Padang (Danau Cimpago area), with distance categories of 1K, 2K, 5K, 10K and 21K.

The half-marathon (21K/UMUM) is described by organizers as the most demanding category, crossing hills and an iconic bridge: "Rute yang paling menantang dan menguji stamina pelari melalui tanjakan dan ikon wilayah Kota Padang."
Cut-off times listed by organizers: 2K Kids 1 hour, 1K Lansia (single/double) 30 minutes, 5K Enjoy 1.5 hours, and 10K Eksotis 2.5 hours.
In the 2025 edition, the route went from Pantai Purus through the old town (Kota Tua) and Gunung Padang before finishing back at Pantai Purus.

Ahead of the 2025 race, the Padang public works department carried out drainage and road-patching work on flood-prone stretches (e.g. near Rusunawa and Hotel Mercure) specifically to smooth the route for runners.
